German State Elections See Major Defeat for Merz's CDU Party

Exit polls indicate a significant defeat for Friedrich Merz's CDU party in two German state elections. The results are described as a 'disaster' for the party. This outcome follows Germany's decision to cut energy taxes to lower petrol prices. Merz has vowed to continue with reforms despite the election results, which some reports characterized as a historic defeat.
